_comment: Self-configured fitness functions over the taskq complexity descriptor (advisory; see references/fitness_functions.md). JSON rather than YAML because the CLI runs under a bare python3 without PyYAML. Encodes the shape settled in validation_artifacts/complexity_decision.md. Deliberately NOT constrained: god_state_count/dense rows -- all three variables are an accepted irreducible small core (outcome + exit code are the CLI's real output channel, with named readers).

fitness_functions.name: bound-stays-small-and-known
fitness_functions.description: the whole-program bound stays resolved and proportional to the 4-status lifecycle over a handful of names; a wide counter or an unconstrained variable breaks this

fitness_functions.name: all-state-visible-and-justified
fitness_functions.description: every variable stays read by some configured invariant and carries a justification linkage; bookkeeping state nothing reads is the one smell this tiny CLI could grow
